jobDescription.text:
The Design Governance Manager leads multidisciplinary design coordination across complex real-estate programmes in the Kingdom.

Key responsibilities:
- Own design governance frameworks and review gateways.
- Manage senior client and stakeholder relationships.
- Drive value engineering, quality assurance and design controls.

Requirements:
- Degree in architecture with strong Saudi project experience.
- Demonstrated team leadership and people management.
- Programme delivery experience on large mixed-use developments.

qualifications.text: Professional registration such as RIBA or Saudi Council of Engineers is preferred.
